# @loom/plugin-sandbox

Hardened QuickJS/WASM sandbox for LLM-authored reshaping code — content-addressed scripts, resource limits, no ambient I/O, shape-hash-validated output (ADR 0064)

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-sandbox`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
